name: WorkBuddy 号池
description: 可选安装的本机 WorkBuddy 号池网关。在设置中添加或删除自备账号认证、查看号池状态，并在会话中使用 WorkBuddy 模型。

features.name: 可选安装的本机号池网关与多账号轮换
features.nameEn: Optional local pool gateway with account rotation

features.name: 号池模型进入会话模型选择
features.nameEn: Pool models in conversation model selection

features.name: 设置内添加、更新与删除本机账号认证
features.nameEn: Add, update and remove local account credentials in settings

features.name: 账号额度、冷却、在途请求与最近状态
features.nameEn: Account credits, cooldown, in-flight requests and recent status

features.name: 可选安装、私有凭据与禁用后停止
features.nameEn: Optional installation, private credentials and disable cleanup
